hints.hr: Kod je datum, ispisan u šest znamenki: dan, mjesec, godina. Bez točaka.
hints.en: The code is a date written as six digits: day, month, year. No dots.

hints.hr: „Prvi dan“ piše rukom na poleđini jedne fotografije u torbi, a skener je u kut utisnuo i datum.
hints.en: "First day" is written by hand on the back of one of the photographs in the bag, and the scanner stamped the date into the corner.
